THE STANDARD MILITARY SIDEARM OF MOST EASTERN EUROPEAN STATES, WIDELY USED BY POLICE AND INTERNAL SECURITY FORCES.

A BELGIAN RIFLE ADOPTED AS THE STANDARD RIFLE OF THE BRITISH ARMY, THE L1A1, ALSO KNOWN AS THE FN-FAL, HAS BEEN REPLACED IN SERVICE BY THE L85. HOWEVER, THE FAL WAS A VERY POPULAR WEAPON AND CAME INTO WIDESPREAD CIVILIAN USE.  SINCE THE OUTBREAK OF THE WAR, NUMERO US FAL'S HAVE BEEN PICKED UP BY MILITARY UNITS, PARTICULARLY THOSE THAT FAVOR THE HEAVIER CARTRIDGE.

THE STANDARD GERMAN ASSAULT RIFLE - UNTIL IT WAS REPLACED BY THE G11 - THE G3 WAS STILL WIDELY USED BY TERRITORIAL AND INTERNAL SECURITY TROOPS AND IS NOW BACK IN SERVICE WITH GERMAN TROOPS. IT IS QUITE POPULAR IN LATIN AMERICA, POSSIBLY SINCE IT IS TAKEN FROM AN EARLIER SPANISH DESIGN.
THE ISRAELI-DESIGNED UZI IS THE MOST COMMON SUBMACHINEGUN.  IT IS USED BY ARMIES AND POLICE AGENCIES WORLDWIDE, INCLUDING THE U.S. SECRET SERVICE AND U.S. FEDERAL MARSHAL SERVICE.
THE STANDARD SUBMACHINEGUN OF GERMAN TERRITORIAL TROOPS AND POLICE.
THE STANDARD EASTERN BLOC MILITARY SUBMACHINEGUN. THE AKR IS MERELY A CUT-DOWN VERSION OF THE AK-74. ALTHOUGH A BIT HEAVY FOR A SUBMACHINEGUN, IT HAS GOOD ACCURACY AND STOPPING POWER.
THE ITALIAN STANDARD MILITARY AND POLICE SUBMACHINEGUN.

A BULLPUP-CONFIGURATION WEAPON THAT IS DIFFERENT FROM OTHER COMBAT RIFLES IN THAT IT FIRES CASELESS 4.7MM BULLETS, WHICH ARE EXTREMELY COMPACT, THUS ALLOWING A LARGE MAGAZINE CAPACITY. SINCE THERE IS NO SPENT CARTRIDGE CASE TO EJECT, THE RIFLE'S ACTION IS COMPLETELY ENCLOSED AND IS HIGHLY RELIABLE IN A DIRTY ENVIRONMENT. HOWEVER, THERE IS NO WAY TO RELOAD THE ROUND SINCE IT IS COMPLETELY CONSUMED.
THE STANDARD COMBAT RIFLE OF THE U.S. AND CANADIAN ARMIES, THE M16 IS IN WIDESPREAD USE AND IS A POPULAR AND EFFECTIVE WEAPON.
THE STANDARD COMBAT RIFLE OF THE EASTERN BLOC FORCES.
THE STANDARD BRITISH COMBAT RIFLE, REPLACING THE FAL.  LIKE THE G11, THE L85 IS A BULLPUP-CONFIGURATION RIFLE.  IT IS RARE OUTSIDE OF BRITISH SERVICE.
THE MODERN VERSION OF THE UBIQUITOUS AK-47. IT IS PERHAPS THE MOST WIDELY USED MILITARY SMALL ARM IN THE WORLD, AND IS VERY POPULAR, DESPITE ITS UNDERPOWERED AND UNSTABLE CARTRIDGE.
THE STANDARD FRENCH MILITARY RIFLE, THE FA-MAS IS RARE OUTSIDE FRENCH SERVICE.  IT IS A BULLPUP-CONFIGURATION WEAPON.
THE STANDARD U.S. MARINE SNIPER RIFLE, THE M40 IS A BOLT-ACTION, MAGAZINE-FED RIFLE WITH A TELESCOPIC SIGHT.
THE STANDARD EASTERN BLOC SNIPER RIFLE, THE SVD IS A SEMIAUTOMATIC, CLIP-FED RIFLE WITH A TELESCOPIC SIGHT.
THE STANDARD U.S. ARMY SNIPER RIFLE, THE M21 IS ESSENTIALLY A WELL MADE M14 ASSAULT RIFLE FITTED WITH A TELESCOPIC SIGHT AND A BIPOD.
THE STANDARD GERMAN SNIPER RIFLE, THE PSG1 IS AN IMPROVED VERSION OF THE G3 ASSAULT RIFLE. IT IS FITTED WITH A TELESCOPIC SIGHT.
PUMP-ACTION SHOTGUNS ARE WIDELY USED IN WESTERN EUROPEAN MILITARY SERVICES.  THE MAGAZINE GIVEN IS FOR A COMMON, EXTENDED-CAPACITY, POLICE-ISSUE WEAPON.
THE STANDARD COMBAT SHOTGUN OF THE GERMAN AND U.S. ARMIES, THE HECKLER AND KOCH CAW IS A BULLPUP CONFIGURATION WEAPON, LIKE THE G11.
THE M249 AUTOMATIC WEAPON IS THE STANDARD U.S. LIGHT AUTOMATIC SUPPORT WEAPON. IT CAN ACCEPT EITHER THE STANDARD 30-ROUND MAGAZINE OF THE M16 OR A 200-ROUND BELT.
THE RPK-74 IS THE STANDARD, WARSAW PACT, LIGHT AUTOMATIC SUPPORT WEAPON. IT CAN ACCEPT EITHER THE SAME MAGAZINE AS THE AK-74 OR AN OVERSIZED MAGAZINE.
THE STANDARD U.S. GENERAL-PURPOSE MACHINEGUN. AN IMPROVED VERSION OF THE WWII GERMAN MG42, IT IS EQUIPPED WITH A BIPOD AND CAN ALSO BE FIRED FROM A TRIPOD.  IT ACCEPTS 100-ROUND BELTS.
THE STANDARD GERMAN GENERAL PURPOSE MACHINEGUN IS A SLIGHTLY IMPROVED COPY OF THE WARTIME MG42. IT IS EQUIPPED WITH A BIPOD AND CAN ALSO BE FIRED FROM A TRIPOD.  IT ACCEPTS 50-ROUND BELTS.
THE STANDARD WARSAW PACT MEDIUM MACHINEGUN, THE PKMG IS USUALLY FOUND MOUNTED ON A VEHICLE.
THE STANDARD INFANTRY GRENADE LAUNCHER OF THE U.S. AND CANADIAN ARMIES, THE M203 IS A SINGLE-SHOT LAUNCHER WHICH IS ATTACHED TO THE BOTTOM OF AN M16 RIFLE.
THE AK-47 GRENADE LAUNCHER WAS DEVELOPED FOR THE AFGHANISTANS. IT CAN BE FITTED TO ANY AK SERIES RIFLE.

THE STANDARD INFANTRY SUPPORT GRENADE LAUNCHER IN THE UNITED STATES ARMY, THE MK-19 IS A TRIPOD MOUNTED, BELT-FED AUTOMATIC WEAPON. IT MAY ALSO FIRE UNBELTED INDIVIDUAL GRENADES. IT MAY ONLY BE FIRED FROM A TRIPOD OR VEHICLE MOUNT.
THE STANDARD WARSAW PACT INFANTRY SUPPORT GRENADE LAUNCHER, THE AGS-17 IS A TRIPOD MOUNTED, DRUM-FED AUTOMATIC GRENADE LAUNCHER.  IT MAY BE FIRED ONLY FROM ITS TRIPOD OR VEHICLE MOUNT.
THE STANDARD WARSAW PACT ANTITANK ROCKET LAUNCHER.
THE REPLACEMENT OF THE M72 LAW IN BRITISH SERVICE, THIS IS A 94MM DISPOSABLE ANTITANK ROCKET LAUNCHER.
THIS IS A SHOULDER-FIRED RECOILESS RIFLE USED AS THE STANDARD MEDIUM ANTITANK AND ASSAULT WEAPON BY GERMANY, BRITAIN, CANADA, THE NETHERLANDS, AND DENMARK.  IT FIRES AN 84MM HEAT ROUND.

THE TANK BREAKER IS A MAN-PORTABLE LAUNCHER FIRED FROM AN INTEGRAL REST. IT FIRES A HOMING FIRE-AND-FORGET MISSILE WHICH CAN BE PROGRAMMED TO HIT A TARGET DIRECTLY, OR SET TO FLY OVER A TANK AND ATTACK IT FROM ABOVE, WHERE THE ARMOR IS GENERALLY THINNER.

THIS AT MISSILE LAUNCHER FIRES THE TOWII MISSILE ON THE M2 BRADLEY. TOW IS AN ACRONYM FOR 'TUBE- LAUNCHED, OPTICALLY-TRACKED, WIRE- GUIDED.' A SENSOR ON THE LAUNCHER TRACKS A LIGHT SOURCE ON THE MISSILE WHILE THE GUNNER KEEPS THE SIGHT'S CROSSHAIRS CENTERED ON THE TARGET.  COURSE CORRECTIONS ARE FED TO THE MISSILE THROUGH THE WIRE LINK TRAILED OUT BY THE MISSILE IN FLIGHT. THE LAUNCHER MAY BE FIRED ONLY FROM THE VEHICLE MOUNT.  THE LAUNCHER CANNOT BE RELOADED FROM INSIDE THE VEHICLE.
THE AT-7 SAXHORN IS A MAN-PORTABLE ANTITANK MISSILE DESIGNED TO GIVE THE RIFLE SQUAD SOME MEANS OF DEALING WITH ARMORED VEHICLES AT MEDIUM TO LONG RANGES.
THE DRAGON PIP IS A MAN-PORTABLE ANTITANK MISSILE DESIGNED TO GIVE THE RIFLE SQUAD SOME MEANS OF DEALING WITH ARMORED VEHICLES AT ME DIUM TO LONG RANGES.
THE M2 HEAVY BARREL IS THE STANDARD HEAVY MACHINEGUN OF EVERY WESTERN EUROPEAN ARMY.  IT ACCEPTS 105-ROUND BELTS AND MAY BE FIRED ONLY FROM A TRIPOD OR FROM A VEHICLE MOUNT.
